what: For each hidden SVG path, the curve is split evenly into 100 points and 100px square cells are placed, turned on one by one at .01s intervals (1s), then turned off in the same order (1s). With several paths, it rests 3s and goes one at a time — loops endlessly and pauses off-screen. A background where a thick pixel snake passes along a staircase path.

options.[data-fx-part=path]: SVG’s <path> — With several, they spin from the second in document order and the first goes last (original order). Color is the svg’s color (currentColor)

from.where: index.js trailLoop · .hero-trail (four stepped hero trails — original WebGL trail: 100 cells·100px·stagger .01, trailLoopTimeline 3s rest·1s on·1s off)

note: The original uses WebGL instanced rectangles — the part draws the same cells as SVG rectangles, so it works without three. Path coordinates are drawn by the consumer
